verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex documents its own REST API, secured with OAuth 2.0 client access, for automating payroll integrations. Documented use cases include syncing employee data from an external HR system, complex check creation, and recurring deductions, so core operations can run programmatically without the UI. However, there is no evidence of a CLI, CI-oriented tooling, or a machine-readable spec: probes found no OpenAPI file or llms.txt. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-runner guidance, a published OpenAPI spec, documented service-account/non-interactive auth flows, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
